sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows caspofungin acetate is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation with initial posting date 2026-01-12.
Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. (US Agent eVenus Pharmaceutical Laboratories, Inc.) posted a discontinuation with initial posting date 2026-06-30.
Corvale General holds 326 vials of the 7 mg/mL, 10.8 mL presentation, providing 20.2 days on hand at current use.

Alternative manufacturers include Gland Pharma Limited and Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC, also not on the shortage list.
